DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive arthritis (Reiter's syndrome).

The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (ankle, now knee), urethritis (pain with urination), and a history of recent sexual activity with inconsistent condom use in a 17-year-old male is highly suggestive of reactive arthritis. I would like to confirm the presence of conjunctivitis or urethral discharge to solidify this diagnosis.
